scope: Альбомная ориентация планшета для первого и второго блоков

prompts.name: Планшет горизонтально · первый экран
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Adapt the supplied exact ЗДОРОВЯКОВ first-screen design into a TABLET LANDSCAPE first viewport, logical 1024x768, 4:3 LANDSCAPE image. This is a raster mockup, not code. Preserve the supplied family identities, sunny golden kitchen, mother adjusting schoolboy son's clothes, father preparing for work, daughter having breakfast, natural photographic warmth and lived-in detail. This is a genuine responsive recomposition for a HORIZONTALLY held tablet, not the narrow portrait screen and not a shrunken desktop. Full-bleed photograph, no device/browser frames or outer board. Logo top left with leaf and exact ЗДОРОВЯКОВ, small signature НАТУРАЛЬНАЯ ЗАБОТА / В КАЖДОМ ДНЕ. Top right readable Доставка / Контакты, cart 0 with touch friendly spacing. Preserve luminous quiet left area for large dark green headline У жизни свой ритм. on 2-3 lines, supporting exact text Каждый день — своя история. beneath. Headline about 56-64 logical pixels, supporting 22-26 logical pixels, comfortable 32px safe margins. Mother and son are emotional center in middle, father at deeper right, daughter lower right; keep faces and body gestures intact. Art-direct their positions and photo framing so the text and faces never overlap and the group feels natural. Lower darker table area contains the centered exact invitation Листайте, жизнь продолжается and a subtle thin downward chevron. No pill buttons, extra CTA, product cards, bottle, price, health claims or extra sections. Deliver just the single tablet landscape hero screenshot with coherent photography and precise Cyrillic typography.

prompts.name: Планшет горизонтально · второй блок
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Adapt the supplied SECOND STORY SECTION into the FULL SCROLLING LAYOUT for a TABLET IN LANDSCAPE orientation, logical viewport width 1024 height 768. Important: this is a full-page capture of the section, so the export is TALL even though the viewport is LANDSCAPE; layout columns and typography must be sized for the 1024px wide tablet. Do not squeeze four stories into one 768px-high viewport. Deliver one full scrolling section about 1024 wide by 1700-1900 tall. Preserve reference family identities, warm photoreal golden lighting, soft ivory canvas, dark forest-green typography, restrained sage and ochre handwritten chapter names and gentle organic cream/photo transitions. Four broad editorial rows, NOT cards: 01 Работа photo left, text right; 02 Движение text left, photo right; 03 Семья photo left, text right; 04 Дача text left, photo right. Each row photograph occupies about 55%, text about 45%, with comfortable tablet readable headings about 28px and body 17-18px, 30px page padding. Do not just shrink the desktop or keep portrait one-column stacking. Header exact На всё, что важно, нужны силы, subtitle Быть в ресурсе — это успевать, наслаждаться и двигаться дальше. 01 Работа: Когда впереди столько задач. Хочется оставаться в ресурсе до самого вечера. Same smiling man with glasses at laptop. 02 Движение: Движение — это удовольствие. Когда остаются силы на себя. Same woman running next to a river. 03 Семья: Чтобы после рабочего дня хватало сил. На себя, семейные дела и любимые моменты вместе. Same mother and schoolboy doing homework. 04 Дача: Чтобы любимые дела оставались в радость. В саду, на даче, в городе — в любом возрасте. Same older couple gardening. Keep all four stories exactly once and in order. No first-screen hero, logo/navigation repeat, product bottle, purchase UI, health/product effect claims, reviews, promises or extra sections. No device frame or outer presentation board. The result is only the second section adapted to a landscape tablet, with natural vertical scrolling.
